scope: GitHub-only model-free curated subset; not a byte-identical complete ZIP extraction.

model.availability: Public unauthenticated Hub API returned HTTP 401 during preparation; obtain authorized artifact separately and verify digest. No model is included.

exclusion_policy.model_runtime_ROM: Never include models, checkpoints, ROMs, PRG/D64 or generated tensor binaries.
exclusion_policy.environment: No credentials, token signatures, private-key material, environments or caches.
exclusion_policy.presentation: Reference existing byte-identical docs/research and assets/interpretability files rather than duplicating reports and figures; other historical prose/visual drafts excluded.
exclusion_policy.transients: Exclude transient logs/test output and nested ZIPs; preserve original scientific Python, JSON manifests/evidence, numeric NPZ/CSV/JSONL and required assembly fixtures.
exclusion_policy.deduplication: Exact SHA-256 deduplication references a single existing repository file; reproduction wrapper materializes each retained member in a fresh scratch copy.
exclusion_policy.privacy: Inventory uses relative member paths and source group IDs only, never source absolute paths, private URLs or credentials. Preserved scientific source may contain historical experiment paths; these are not portable instructions.

groups.note: No study003 source/evidence ZIP exists in the supplied research root; original files recovered directly. No original archive identity claimed.

groups.audit: CRC, SHA-256 pin, normalized relative paths, duplicate paths, symlinks/special files, encryption, size and ratio bounds checked before extraction
